Remark 5.5\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0103 ↗ hanlin:ch05-def-5-4 If \[ a_{ij}D_{ij}u=f\quad \text{in }\Omega \] is uniformly elliptic with constants $\lambda ,\Lambda $, then its viscosity supersolutions lie in $S^+(\lambda ,\Lambda ,f)$. These extremal classes also contain viscosity solutions of fully nonlinear uniformly elliptic equations.
